description: Na₃CoCPO₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁ space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent CoO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.46 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.77 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.63 Å. Co is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted CoO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 2.02-2.19 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.29-1.31 Å. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and corners with three equivalent CoO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 51-55°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.58 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Co, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Co, and one P atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂CoP trigonal pyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Co, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Co, and one C atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to three Na and one P atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₃P trigonal pyramids. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Co, and one P atom.
